title: Iconic World Cup Moments
description: The goals, dramas and images burned into World Cup memory.

questions.q: Who scored the 'Hand of God' and the 'Goal of the Century' in the same 1986 match?
questions.explain: Maradona did both against England in the quarter-final.

questions.q: Who scored a hat-trick in the 2022 final — the first in a final since 1966?
questions.explain: Mbappé scored three but still finished on the losing side.

questions.q: Who scored a hat-trick in the 1966 final for England?
questions.explain: Geoff Hurst's hat-trick beat West Germany 4–2.

questions.q: Which goalkeeper made a legendary save from Pelé's header in 1970?
questions.explain: England's Gordon Banks produced 'the save of the century'.

questions.q: Whose extra-time goal won Spain their first World Cup in 2010?
questions.explain: Iniesta scored late in extra time against the Netherlands.

questions.q: Which player famously cried during the 1990 semi-final after a booking?
questions.explain: Gazza's tears came after a yellow card that would have ruled him out of the final.

questions.q: Brazil's stunning 2014 semi-final defeat to Germany ended with what scoreline?
questions.explain: Germany beat the hosts 7–1 in Belo Horizonte.

questions.q: Which striker scored five goals across the 2002 tournament to win it for Brazil?
questions.explain: Ronaldo scored eight in 2002, including both goals in the final.
